create_ImageNetXImageFolder: create an ImageNetXImageFolder dataset that loads ImageNet validation samples with ImageNetX annotations
create_ImageNetX: create an ImageNetX dataset that loads ImageNet samples with ImageNetX factor annotations
run_get_vanilla_transform: run get_vanilla_transform to build a torchvision transform with resize, center crop, and normalization
run_format_dataset_entry: run format_dataset_entry to convert a dataset tuple into a dict with class label and factor
run_display_sample_df: run display_sample_df to sample random images from a dataset and display them as an HTML table
